elements.title: Monthly Consumption of Coal for Electricity Generation in the United States from 2016 to 2022

values.Value: blue line fluctuating between about 25,000 and 65,000 with seasonal peaks and troughs
values.SMA: red line smoother, generally declining from about 55,000 to 40,000 over time
values.Diff: green line fluctuating around zero, ranging roughly from -20,000 to 20,000

elements.summary: This line chart shows the monthly coal consumption for electricity generation in the US from 2016 to 2022, with the original values, a simple moving average (SMA), and the difference between them, illustrating seasonal variation and trends.

elements.label: Figure 5.17
elements.title: Pure Seasonal Variation. The same pattern repeats after 64 time steps, and so the period is 64.

details.values: The line oscillates smoothly with peaks near 4 and troughs near -4, repeating the same pattern every 64 time steps.

elements.summary: This line chart illustrates a pure seasonal variation time series with a repeating pattern every 64 time steps, demonstrating the concept of seasonality and period in time series analysis.
